class.name: GameplayPredictionModel
class.brief_description: Fixed-step kinematic model shared by prediction and authority.
class.description: GameplayPredictionModel maps normalized movement intent directly to velocity and advances position for one fixed step. Running the same ordered commands from the same state produces the same result on client and server. Games can replace this bounded sample model instead of treating it as a general character or physics rollback system.
